item.title: Upper Darby deadly custody dispute leaves 3 kids without a mother: police
item.description: A custody exchange turned deadly in Upper Darby Township, leaving three children without their mother. Upper Darby Police found a female and male with gunshot wounds on the 200 block of Copley Road on Friday at around noon.Officers found a woman with a gunshot wound behind the vehicle and a man with a gunshot wound on the sidewalk.
